title: Draft Q1 flux commentary
learnerBrief: The CFO wants two sentences on Q1 opex movement for tomorrow's board deck. Q1 opex is up roughly $570K versus Q4. Draft the commentary and tell me what's driving it.

groundTruth.memo: Reclass per capitalization policy change CP-2026-01 (board-approved 2/26)
groundTruth.summaryStory: Opex up ~$570K QoQ; the summary-visible story is professional services up ~$386K (the genuine ~$94K step-up MERGED with the $280K reclass into the same 6100 line; the honest summary read is 'consulting spend increased'). The actual dominant driver is the reclass, booked in a single 3/31 JE, invisible in every summary view by construction.
